metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: The absurd antics of an Indiana town's public officials as they pursue sundry projects to make their city a better place.

metas.name: Daredevil
metas.description: A blind lawyer by day, vigilante by night. Matt Murdock fights the crime of New York as Daredevil.

metas.name: Industry
metas.description: Young bankers and traders make their way in the financial world in the aftermath of the 2008 collapse.

metas.name: Ozark
metas.description: A financial advisor drags his family from Chicago to the Missouri Ozarks, where he must launder money to appease a drug boss.

metas.name: True Blood
metas.description: Thanks to a Japanese scientist's invention of synthetic blood, vampires have progressed overnight from legendary monsters to fellow citizens. And while humans have been safely removed from the menu, many remain apprehensive about these creatures "coming out of the coffin." Religious leaders, government officials, and vampire fundamentalists around the world have chosen their sides.  But in the small Louisiana town of Bon Temps, the jury is still out.

metas.name: Daredevil: Born Again
metas.description: Matt Murdock finds himself on a collision course with Wilson Fisk when their past identities begin to emerge.

metas.name: Foundation
metas.description: A complex saga of humans scattered on planets throughout the galaxy all living under the rule of the Galactic Empire.

metas.name: The Crown
metas.description: Follows the political rivalries and romances of Queen Elizabeth II's reign and the events that shaped Britain for the second half of the 20th century.

metas.name: Cape Fear
metas.description: A happily married couple faces a growing threat when a notorious killer from their past, Max Cady, is released from prison and seeks revenge.

metas.name: Adults
metas.description: A twenty-something ensemble comedy centering on codependent housemates navigating adulthood together despite their flaws.

metas.name: Hacks
metas.description: Explores a dark mentorship that forms between Deborah Vance, a legendary Las Vegas comedian, and a young adult coming to grips through comedy.

metas.name: One Tree Hill
metas.description: Half-brothers Lucas and Nathan Scott trade between kinship and rivalry both on the basketball court and in the hearts of their friends in the small, but not so quiet town of Tree Hill, North Carolina.

metas.name: The Night Agent
metas.description: Low-level FBI agent Peter Sutherland works in the basement of the White House manning a phone that never rings - until the night it does, propelling him into a conspiracy that leads all the way to the Oval Office.

metas.name: The Agency
metas.description: A covert CIA agent is ordered to abandon his undercover life and return to his Station; when the love he left behind reappears, romance reignites.

metas.name: Lupin
metas.description: Inspired by the adventures of Arsène Lupin, gentleman thief Assane Diop sets out to avenge his father for an injustice inflicted by a wealthy family.

metas.name: Shogun
metas.description: When a mysterious European ship is found marooned in a nearby Japanese fishing village, Lord Yoshii Toranaga discovers secrets that could tip the scales of power and devastate his enemies.

metas.name: Mindhunter
metas.description: In the late 1970s, two FBI agents broaden the realm of criminal science by investigating the psychology behind murder and end up getting too close to real-life monsters.

metas.name: Colin from Accounts
metas.description: A microbrewery owner and a student doctor are brought together by a car accident that injures a stray dog they agree to adopt, forcing them to navigate each other's vulnerabilities.

metas.name: Beef
metas.description: Minor conflicts spiral into consuming feuds between individuals, exposing pride, resentment, and hidden pain.

metas.name: The Day of the Jackal
metas.description: The Jackal is an elusive assassin who makes his living carrying out hits for the highest fee. He soon meets his match in a tenacious British intelligence officer who tracks him down in a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase across Europe.

metas.name: You
metas.description: A charming and intense young man inserts himself into the lives of women who fascinate him.

metas.name: Lucifer
metas.description: Lucifer Morningstar has decided that he's had enough of being the dutiful servant in Hell and decides to spend some time on Earth to better understand humanity. He settles in Los Angeles--the City of Angels.

metas.name: Vigil
metas.description: The mysterious disappearance of a Scottish fishing trawler and a death onboard a Trident nuclear submarine bring the police into conflict with the Navy and British security services.

metas.name: 3 Body Problem
metas.description: A fateful decision made in 1960s China reverberates in the present, where a group of scientists partner with a detective to confront an existential planetary threat.

metas.name: The Penguin
metas.description: Following the events of The Batman (2022), Oz Cobb, a.k.a. the Penguin, makes a play to seize the reins of the crime world in Gotham.
Multinational immigrants traveling from the old continent to the new encounter a nightmarish riddle aboard a second ship adrift on the open sea.

metas.name: The Expanse
metas.description: The disappearance of rich-girl-turned-political-activist links the lives of a Ceres detective, an accidental ship captain and U.N. politician. Amidst political tension between Earth, Mars and the Belt, they unravel the greatest co...

metas.name: Heated Rivalry
metas.description: Two rival hockey stars at the top of their game face an unexpected challenge when they develop feelings for each other, complicating their careers and the sport's expectations.

metas.name: Bridgerton
metas.description: The eight close-knit siblings of the Bridgerton family look for love and happiness in London high society.

metas.name: The Shards
metas.description: The Shards is part teenage coming of age, erotic thriller and exploration of the untamed and mysterious era of Los Angeles 1981, tracking a group of privileged high school friends as a serial killer strikes across the city.

metas.name: The Middle
metas.description: The daily mishaps of a married woman and her semi-dysfunctional family and their attempts to survive life in general in the town of Orson, Indiana.

metas.name: Stick
metas.description: An over-the-hill ex-golfer, fired from his job, sees hope in coaching a troubled teen prodigy after his wife leaves him, staking his future on the youth's success.

metas.name: Spider-Noir
metas.description: Ben Reilly, a seasoned, down-on-his-luck private investigator in 1930s New York, is forced to grapple with his past life, following a deeply personal tragedy, as the city's one and only superhero.

metas.name: Tip Toe
metas.description: Neighbors Leo, a Canal Street bar owner, and Clive, an electrician with teen sons, find their lives unraveling as social tensions rise. Simple disagreements escalate into dangerous hostility in their Manchester suburb.

metas.name: Legends
metas.description: Customs agents go undercover to infiltrate Britain's most dangerous drug gangs, following a thrilling criminal investigation based on extensive research and interviews with those involved in the top-secret operation.

metas.name: The Terror
metas.description: Supernatural, semihistorical horror anthology series, where each season is inspired by a different infamous or mysterious real-life historical tragedy.

metas.name: Star Trek: The Next Generation
metas.description: Set almost 100 years after Captain Kirk's five-year mission, a new generation of Starfleet officers sets off in the U.S.S. Enterprise-D on its own mission to go where no one has gone before.

metas.name: Two and a Half Men
metas.description: A hedonistic jingle writer's free-wheeling life comes to an abrupt halt when his brother and 10-year-old nephew move into his Malibu beach house.

metas.name: Ted
metas.description: It's 1993, and Ted the bear's moment of fame has passed. He's living back home with his best friend, John Bennett, and his family. While Ted may be a lousy influence on John, he's a loyal pal who will go out on a limb for friendship.
The Duttons face a new set of challenges in the early 20th century, including the rise of Western expansion, Prohibition, and the Great Depression.

metas.name: The Madison
metas.description: A New York family's life unravels after a tragedy; they process their grief while vacationing in rural Montana, where they explore human connection amid their profound sorrow.

metas.name: Westworld
metas.description: At the intersection of the near future and the reimagined past, waits a world in which every human appetite can be indulged without consequence.

metas.name: Downton Abbey
metas.description: A chronicle of the lives of the British aristocratic Crawley family and their servants in the early twentieth century.

metas.name: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
metas.description: Comic book store owner Stuart Bloom, from The Big Bang Theory (2007), returns in a new series where he attempts—and apparently fails—to save the universe, staying true to his unlucky nature.

metas.name: Arcane
metas.description: Amid the stark discord of twin cities Piltover and Zaun, two sisters fight on rival sides of a war between magic technologies and clashing convictions.

metas.name: Six Feet Under
metas.description: When death is your business, what is your life? Laced with irony and dark situational humor, the show approaches the subject of death through the eyes of the Fisher family, who owns and operates a funeral home in Los Angeles.

metas.name: Babylon Berlin
metas.description: Colognian commissioner Gereon Rath moves to Berlin, the epicenter of political and social changes in the Golden Twenties.

metas.name: Stargate SG-1
metas.description: Set after the events of the Stargate (1994) movie, the series follows SG-1, one of many secret military teams of soldiers and scientists who travel through a gateway to other planets and fight against dangerous aliens to protect e...

metas.name: The Haunting of Bly Manor
metas.description: After an au pair’s tragic death, Henry hires a young American nanny to care for his orphaned niece and nephew who reside at Bly Manor with the chef Owen, groundskeeper Jamie and housekeeper, Mrs. Grose.

metas.name: Once Upon a Time
metas.description: A young woman with a troubled past is drawn to a small town in Maine where fairy tales are to be believed.

metas.name: Friday Night Lights
metas.description: A drama that follows the lives of the Dillon Panthers, one of the nation's best high school football teams, and their head coach Eric Taylor.

metas.name: Major Crimes
metas.description: The Closer (2005) spin-off series, which follows Captain Raydor of the Los Angeles Police Department.

metas.name: Star Trek
metas.description: In the 23rd Century, Captain James T. Kirk and the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise explore the galaxy and defend the United Federation of Planets.

metas.name: Avatar: The Last Airbender
metas.description: A young boy known as the Avatar must master the four elemental powers to save the world, and fight against an enemy bent on stopping him.

metas.name: Black Doves
metas.description: After her lover is murdered by members of London's underworld, a spy - who is publicly the wife of the British Defence Secretary - is protected by an old friend from their agency.

metas.name: Fringe
metas.description: An F.B.I. agent is forced to work with an institutionalized scientist and his son in order to rationalize a brewing storm of unexplained phenomena.

metas.name: Sex Education
metas.description: A teenage boy with a sex-therapist mother teams up with a high-school classmate to set up an underground sex-therapy clinic at school.

metas.name: Justified
metas.description: Enforcing his own brand of justice, U.S. Marshal Raylan Givens, a strong-willed, quiet law-man haunted by his past, returns to his native town to see that justice is served to those in need.

metas.name: The Chelsea Detective
metas.description: Detective Inspector Max Arnold, whose lifestyle on a battered houseboat in Chelsea's Cheyne Walk contrasts sharply with the affluent elite whose crimes he helps solve alongside partner DS Layla Walsh.

metas.name: My Hero Academia
metas.description: A superhero-admiring boy enrolls in a prestigious hero academy and learns what it really means to be a hero, after the strongest superhero grants him his own powers.

metas.name: Desperate Housewives
metas.description: A close-knit group of housewives reside in Wisteria Lane. It may appear to be a seemingly perfect neighborhood but it hides many secrets, crimes, forbidden romances and domestic struggles.

metas.name: Peacemaker
metas.description: Picking up where The Suicide Squad (2021) left off, Peacemaker returns home after recovering from his encounter with Bloodsport - only to discover that his freedom comes at a price.

metas.name: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
metas.description: Two brothers search for a Philosopher's Stone after an attempt to revive their deceased mother goes awry and leaves them in damaged physical forms.

The post-Civil war generation of the Dutton family travels to Texas, and joins a wagon train undertaking the arduous journey west to Oregon, before settling in Montana to establish what would eventually become the Yellowstone Ranch.

metas.name: Fleabag
metas.description: Series adapted from the award-winning play about a young woman trying to cope with life in London whilst coming to terms with a recent tragedy.

metas.name: Vinland Saga
metas.description: Following a tragedy, Thorfinn embarks on a journey with the man responsible for it to take his life in a duel as a true and honorable warrior.

metas.name: The Legend of Korra
metas.description: Avatar Korra fights to keep Republic City safe from the evil forces of both the physical and spiritual worlds.

metas.name: Dept. Q
metas.description: Carl, a former top-rated detective, is wracked with guilt following an attack that left his partner paralyzed and another policeman dead. On his return to work, Carl is assigned to a cold case that will consume his life.

metas.name: The Twilight Zone
metas.description: Ordinary people face uncanny and impossible events in standalone tales of science fiction, fantasy, horror, and suspense.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: After being a victim of fraud, Johnny Rose and his family go from extremely wealthy to penniless overnight. The only asset left to them is a small, unsophisticated town: Schitt's Creek. They relocate there. Culture shock ensues.

metas.name: Hawaii Five-0
metas.description: When United States Navy officer, Steve McGarrett, returns home to Oahu to find his father's killer, the Governor offers him the chance to run his own special task force: Five-0.

metas.name: The Night Of
metas.description: After a night of partying with a woman he picked up, a man wakes up to find her stabbed to death and is charged with her murder.

metas.name: The Boroughs
metas.description: In a seemingly picturesque retirement community, a group of unlikely heroes must band together to stop an otherworldly threat from stealing the one thing they don't have - time.

metas.name: Scrubs
metas.description: In the unreal world of Sacred Heart Hospital, intern John "J.D." Dorian learns the ways of medicine, friendship and life.

metas.name: The Night Manager
metas.description: The night manager of a Cairo hotel is recruited to infiltrate an arms dealer's inner circle.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A look into the nightly lives of four vampires who have lived together on Staten Island for over a century.

metas.name: Dark Winds
metas.description: Follows Leaphorn and Chee, two Navajo police officers in the 1970s Southwest that are forced to challenge their own spiritual beliefs when they search for clues in a double murder case.

metas.name: Money Heist
metas.description: To carry out the biggest heist in history, a mysterious man called The Professor recruits a band of eight robbers who have a single characteristic: none of them has anything to lose. Five months of seclusion - memorizing every step, every detail, every probability - culminate in eleven days locked up in the National Coinage and Stamp Factory of Spain, surrounded by police forces and with dozens of hostages in their power, to find out whether their suicide wager will lead to everything or nothing.

metas.name: The Last Kingdom
metas.description: As Alfred the Great defends his kingdom from Norse invaders, Uhtred--born a Saxon but raised by Vikings--seeks to claim his ancestral birthright.

metas.name: The Sex Lives of College Girls
metas.description: Four 18-year-old freshman roommates at Essex College in Vermont. A bundle of contradictions and hormones, these sexually active college girls are equal parts lovable and infuriating.

metas.name: Chad Powers
metas.description: A disgraced college quarterback named Russ Holliday disguises himself as Chad Powers and walks onto a struggling southern football team to revive his football career.

metas.name: DTF St. Louis
metas.description: A darkly comedic tale of three middle-aged individuals entangled in a love triangle, leading to one's untimely demise.

metas.name: New Girl
metas.description: After a bad break-up, Jess, an offbeat young woman, moves into an apartment loft with three single men. Although they find her behavior very unusual, the men support her - most of the time.

metas.name: Outer Banks
metas.description: On North Carolina's Outer Banks, a tight-knit group of working-class teenagers known as the Pogues embark on dangerous treasure hunts, uncovering buried secrets, family mysteries, romance, and rivalries while fighting to stay toge...

metas.name: Poirot
metas.description: Hercule Poirot, a famous Belgian detective, who has an impeccable knack for getting embroiled in a mystery, solves crimes along with Captain Hastings and Scotland Yard Chief Inspector James Japp.

metas.name: Animal Kingdom
metas.description: Centers on a Southern California family, whose excessive lifestyle is fueled by their criminal activities.

metas.name: The Flash
metas.description: After being struck by lightning, Barry Allen wakes up from his coma to discover he's been given the power of super speed, becoming the Flash, and fighting crime in Central City.

metas.name: Rome
metas.description: The lives of both illustrious and ordinary Romans in the last days of the Roman Republic.

metas.name: Rivals
metas.description: Follows Rupert Campbell-Black and Tony Baddingham as they have a longstanding rivalry that comes to a head.

metas.name: Sex and the City
metas.description: Four career women navigate life in NYC. Carrie writes about relationships, Charlotte runs an art gallery, Miranda practices law, and Samantha excels in PR. Each brings unique views on love, work, and friendship.

metas.name: Squid Game
metas.description: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. A tempting prize awaits, but with deadly high stakes.

metas.name: Battlestar Galactica
metas.description: When an old enemy, the Cylons, resurface and obliterate the 12 colonies, the crew of the aged Galactica protect a small civilian fleet - the last of humanity - as they journey toward the fabled 13th colony, Earth.

metas.name: Mr Inbetween
metas.description: Ray Shoesmith is a father, ex-husband, boyfriend, brother and best friend; tough roles to juggle in the modern age. Especially, when you're also a criminal for hire.

metas.name: Blue Bloods
metas.description: Follows the professional and personal lives of the Reagans, a family of New York Cops, who all work in different positions of law enforcement and work together to solve crimes and protect the city from danger.

metas.name: Boardwalk Empire
metas.description: An Atlantic City politician plays both sides of the law by conspiring with gangsters during the Prohibition era.

metas.name: Line of Duty
metas.description: British crime drama series following a team of elite detectives tasked with investigating police corruption.

metas.name: Task
metas.description: In the working-class suburbs of Philadelphia, an FBI agent heads a task force to put an end to a string of violent robberies led by an unsuspected family man.

metas.name: BoJack Horseman
metas.description: BoJack Horseman was the star of the hit television show "Horsin' Around" in the '80s and '90s, but now he's washed up, living in Hollywood, complaining about everything, and wearing colorful sweaters.

metas.name: All Creatures Great & Small
metas.description: The heartwarming life and work of country vets in the 1930s and 1940s Yorkshire Dales, based on the beloved books by James Herriot.

metas.name: Insecure
metas.description: Follows the awkward experiences and racy tribulations of a modern-day African-American woman.
